questions.question:
Which two mathematical symbols should be interchanged to make the following equation balanced?

56 - 39 × 4 ÷ 12 + 33 = 36
questions.solution:
By using BODMAS RULE.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/925174596c6eaf3af22fd77ac6e65ceb7d36b4e1ea56a4157301790f5fc85f1c.png] 

Option 1) ×, ÷ 

Given equation : 56 - 39 × 4 ÷ 12 + 33 = 36

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 

__
 
• ⇒ 56 - **39 ÷ 4**__ × 12 + 33 = 36
 
• ⇒ 56 - __**9.75 × **____**12**__ + 33 = 36
 
• ⇒ __**56**__ - 117 __**+ 33**__ = 36
 
• ⇒ __**89 - 117**__ = 36
 
• ⇒ -28 ≠ 36

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : +, × 

Given equation : 56 - 39 × 4 ÷ 12 + 33 = 36

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 

__
 
• ⇒ 56 - 39 + **4 ÷ 12**__ × 33 = 36
 
• ​⇒ 56 - 39 + __**0.33 × 33**__ = 36
 
• ⇒ __**56**__ - 39 __**+ 11**__ = 36
 
• ⇒ **__67__****__ - 39__** = 36
 
• ⇒ 28 ≠ 36

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : -, ÷ 

Given equation : 56 - 39 × 4 ÷ 12 + 33 = 36

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 

__
 
• ⇒ **56 ÷ __****__39__** × 4 - 12 + 33 = 36
 
• ⇒ __**1.4358**____** × 4**__ - 12 + 33 = 36
 
• ⇒ **__5.7435__** - 12 **__+ 33__** = 36
 
• ⇒ **__38.7435__****__ - __****__12__** = 36
 
• ⇒ 26.7435 ≠ 36

LHS ≠ RHS

**Option 4) : +, -**

**Given equation : 56 - 39 × 4 ÷ 12 + 33 = 36**

**After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows :**

__
 
• **⇒ 56 + 39 × 4 ÷ 12__ - 33 = 36**
 
• **⇒ __56 +____ 13__ - 33 = 36**
 
• **⇒ __69____ -____ 33__ = 36**
 
• **⇒ 36 = 36**

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"+, -".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/547bae813256d0f2f97560bbb4844bd235402cf38ee86b3d27fe364fce77a37a.png]
questions.solution:
The given figure,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cecc1162a3cb4f440449e103ada59aa095b157865887238eeb4e5d70f8655497.png] 

**S****tandard Dice:** **Sum of its any opposite sides are 7**. If the sum of the adjacent two surfaces is not 7, then it can be the standard dice.

So, opposite sides of a standard dice is

1 + 6 = 7, 3 + 4 = 7 and 2 + 5 = 7 

**Here, either 3 and 2 or 5 and 4 need to be interchanged to make a standard dice.**

As 5, 4 do not present in any option. So, 3, 2 will be the correct answer.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option(3)".

questions.question: When a number is subtracted from the square of 17, then the sum becomes 3 times the smallest whole number. Find the number subtracted.
questions.solution:
Given :-

The number is subtracted from the square of 17 = X

The sum become 3 times the smallest whole number :

17² - X = 3 × smallest whole number

Smallest whole number = Zero (0).

Sum becomes 3 times smallest whole number = 0

17² - X = 3 × 0

17² - X = 0

X = 17²

**X = 289.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"289".**
